hypothesis: Test five simple, static factors from daily_pv.h5: MOM20 = $close_t / $close_{t-20} - 1; REV5 = -($close_t / $close_{t-5} - 1); LOWVOL20 = -Std($close_i / $close_{i-1} - 1, i = t-19,...,t), requiring 20 returns; VOLSURPRISE20 = $volume_t / Mean($volume_{t-20},...,$volume_{t-1}) - 1; and CLV1 = (2*$close_t - $high_t - $low_t) / ($high_t - $low_t), set to missing when the daily range is zero. Each factor is a separate output with fixed lookbacks and uses only information available through day t.
reason: These factors rapidly test distinct and widely supported effects—medium-term momentum, short-term reversal, low-volatility behavior, abnormal trading activity, and intraday buying pressure—without introducing fragile combinations or model-dependent complexity. Their low implementation cost and differing information sources make them suitable first-round benchmarks; successful factors should be added to the library, while the results will indicate which direction merits more refined horizons or normalization.
